title: Every $k$-chromatic graph contains a $k$-critical subgraph
statement: Let $G$ be a finite simple graph whose chromatic number is $\chi(G) = k$. Then $G$ contains a subgraph $H$ that is $k$-critical, that is, $H$ satisfies $\chi(H) = k$ and $\chi(H') < \chi(H)$ for every proper subgraph $H' \subset H$.
